name: ButtonGroup
description: A group of mutually exclusive (radio) or multi-select (checkbox) buttons. Clones each Button child, injecting shared sizing, kind, and selection props for consistent visual grouping.

keyboardInteraction: Tab — moves focus between buttons in the group
Enter / Space — activates the focused button
ariaAttributes: aria-pressed (on each child Button via isSelected)
notes: Each child Button receives isSelected which sets aria-pressed.
When disabled is true on the group, all child buttons are disabled.
The root element has role="group" to associate the buttons semantically.

mode.description: Selection mode. 'radio' for single selection, 'checkbox' for multi-selection.

selected.description: Currently selected index (radio mode) or array of selected indices (checkbox mode).

onChange.description: Called when the user clicks a button. Receives the click event and the button index.

size.description: Size applied to all child buttons.

shape.description: Shape applied to all child buttons. First and last children get appropriate border-radius.

kind.description: Visual kind applied to all child buttons.

disabled.description: Disables all buttons in the group.

children.description: Button elements to render inside the group.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the root element.

do: Use ButtonGroup for toggle-style selection between a small set of options.
Keep the number of options between 2 and 5 for best usability.
Use radio mode for mutually exclusive choices, checkbox mode for multi-select.
dont: Do not mix different component types as children — only use Button.
Do not use for navigation — use Tabs or SegmentedControl instead.
Do not use more than 5 options — consider a Select for larger sets.
